workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI interactive selection IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can prepare, persist, validate, and retain validation proof facts, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room contract for bare vihs no-argument interactive selection.

splitDecision.reason: Interactive selection is the next discoverability unit after validation proof artifacts, but it should be admitted as a pure selection-state contract before terminal process wiring, compare execution, runtime execution, live-session proof, packaging, or Marketplace behavior.
doNotAdmitTogether: terminal process wiring or raw stdin prompt loops
proof-out file writing beyond the existing pure proof artifact contract
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof

allowed: supporting public test expectations TEST-UNIT-353 and TEST-UNIT-354
package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
public selection fields for provider, platform, LabVIEW version, and LabVIEW bitness
supported host choices for LabVIEW 2025, LabVIEW 2026, and newer local supported host versions when the selected installation and bitness are present
Linux host selection constrained to supported Linux host proof semantics with x64 only for the first public MIT contract
exact copyable next-command guidance for non-interactive surfaces
validation reuse after confirmation through the already public vihs --validate readback contract
stable fail-closed reasons for unsupported years, host/platform mismatch, missing selected bitness, unsupported Docker bitness, unsupported Docker year, and not-yet-implemented paths
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
private proof packets or private issue templates
proof-out file writing beyond the existing pure proof artifact contract
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateImplementationWork: add tests proving bare vihs seeds missing settings to host/windows/2026/x86 and reports the current provider/platform/version/bitness bundle
add tests proving Enter-through confirmation preserves the current governed selection and requests validation through the existing validation readback contract
add tests proving guided host selection accepts supported LabVIEW 2025, LabVIEW 2026, and newer local host choices while failing closed for unsupported years or missing selected bitness
add tests proving Docker selection remains bounded to 2026 / x64
implement the minimum public MIT interactive-selection contract as pure selection state and output facts, without process stdin loops or runtime execution

candidateTasks: add tests for default settings seeding and current bundle reporting
add tests for Enter-through confirmation and validation readback reuse
add tests for guided host selection and fail-closed unsupported host paths
add tests for bounded Docker 2026 / x64 selection
implement the pure interactive selection contract
blockedTasks: terminal process wiring or raw stdin prompt loops
proof-out file writing beyond the existing pure proof artifact contract
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
source copying from GitLab or GitHub Suite

allowedNextWork: create the public MIT import packet for runtime-settings-cli-interactive-selection-v1
create the public Spec Kit feature spec, plan, and tasks
add public admission records with implementationStartAllowed false until preflight passes
run public redaction and artifact validation
notAllowedNextWork: implementing interactive selection before public preflight
adding terminal process prompt loops before a separate IAU
adding proof-out file writing beyond the existing pure proof artifact contract
copying runtime settings implementation source from another VI History authority
adding VSIX packaging or Marketplace publishing
